name: apm-hub-tools
description: Tools for managing GitHub Copilot templates

scripts.generate:diagrams: mmdc -p .puppeteer-config.json -i docs/diagrams/mental-model-layers.mmd -o docs/diagrams/mental-model-layers.svg -b transparent && mmdc -p .puppeteer-config.json -i docs/diagrams/mental-model-sequence.mmd -o docs/diagrams/mental-model-sequence.svg -b transparent && mmdc -p .puppeteer-config.json -i docs/diagrams/overview-mental-model.mmd -o docs/diagrams/overview-mental-model.svg -b transparent
scripts.generate:all: npm run build && npm run generate:ci && npm run generate:diagrams
scripts.test:integration: cd test/integration && npm install --silent && vitest run
